detail.body:
As noted in https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/147588, the `H2Upgraded` type in hyper wrongly uses a `repr(transparent)` value on a stuct containing `enum Neutered {}`. It seems that this was making use of behavior of the current compiler that isn't specified, and would like to be changed.

That code should be refactored to no longer need such a `repr(transparent)` transmute.

labels.description: Category: bug. Something is wrong. This is bad!
labels.name: C-bug

labels.description: Effort: hard. Likely requires a deeper understanding of how hyper's internals work.
labels.name: E-hard

detail.title: HTTP/2 Upgraded wrongly uses a transparent uninhabited type
